status: Wave 1 verdict: every region LOSES the blind test vs Destiny 2. 12 fresh-context critics inspected the live build. The single biggest cross-cutting bug: the shared prop-kit stone material renders as terracotta brick in six regions (Elderheart, celestial ruins, dwarven gate, Lost monoliths, infernal cliffs, void isle undersides). Second: floating isles read as UFO discs. Third: midday atmosphere is cheerful in the cursed regions. Wave 2 launching: ~10 builders on disjoint files + a fresh AI-generated texture set (bark, marble, basalt, voidstone, ice, flagstone...), then fresh critics re-judge each region.
